name: price-submission-handler
description: Lambda function to handle price submissions with DynamoDB storage and make.com webhook

scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.js node_modules dist && cd dist && zip -q -r function.zip .
scripts.deploy: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name price-submission-handler --zip-file fileb://dist/function.zip
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name price-submission-handler-staging --zip-file fileb://dist/function.zip
